# Teacher Feature

Local Z5 R1/071126 matches fresh archive story bytes and catalog. The author solution gives no release or serial; exact guide edition is unspecified. The separately archived Inform source corroborates the report-card ending, but its compilation identity has not been established and it is not a replacement story pin.

Follow the full school-day route through the teachers, fellow pupils and secretary, acquire the report and continue through every report-card page to the authored ending. The supplementary source sets deadflag=2 only after that multi-page report sequence. A score, GET REPORT command, menu or first report page alone is insufficient. Preserve intended alternate conclusions if actually observed.

The author guide is one comma-separated command chain; the normalized copy adds line breaks at comma-space boundaries without rewriting commands. Follow actual parser state and conversations. Report-card pages use requested single-key pauses; clear them before any SAVE. The source port history (QuickBASIC, PHP, Inform) is not evidence that editions are identical. Maintain the established teacher-feature family shared with Lecture Feature; this is the distinct earlier game, not another Lecture release.

CENTRAL architecture: story files, full guides, provenance and interpreter execution remain on the central host. Pis receive only small broker help excerpts, never story files or full guides. Do not stage or copy these assets to a Pi. Do not expose central guide/source paths or URLs to Muse. Use small topic-specific broker help excerpts only (at most 9 lines / 1000 characters); no full-guide reads, direct URL access or serial excerpts to reconstruct the guide. Hints are suggested help, not observed success. Resolve startup questions/key pauses first. Make an early safe checkpoint and milestone saves only at confirmed ordinary command prompts; verify actual success. Menu Enter means an empty command, not literal space or the word RETURN; other keys only as requested on screen. On timeout use await_output only: no flush commands, extra keys, repeated input or new SAVE. Collect useful varied labeled synthetic probes and actual same-intent repairs with event IDs, not quotas or repeated filler. Use one command at a time near hazards/questions/menus. Parent independently verifies actual concluding narrative against raw output. No training, evaluation or publication.

events.response:
Welcome to the world of St Borogrund's School - a world of intrigue, mystery, 
deceit, and excruciatingly bad dinners. Above a scattering of ugly grey 
outbuildings, Borogrund's four-storey tower block rises to assault the eye in a 
bitter and largely futile attempt to get a second glance. 

The end of term looms, and with it the prospect of your school report. Your 
parents have made it very clear that the report must praise you as a talented 
and conscientious individual. Being none of the above - but ever loyal to your 
parents - you make it your quest to seek out the offending report and... amend 
it. 

Borogrund's isn't just a strange name. It's a strange place. Expect the 
unexpected. Predict the unpredictable. And for pity's sake, don't go into the 
staff room unprepared...


Teacher Feature
(c) Copyright 1998, 2006 Paul Equinox Collins.
Release 1 / Serial number 071126 / Inform v6.30 Library 6/10 

Form room
Sunlight filters into your form room, where you are obliged to register each 
morning and afternoon, and falls across the tables as though reluctant to get 
itself dusty on the linoleum floor. The school's budgetary concerns are 
manifested in the hard wooden chairs and scratched, worn desks which surround 
you. A doorway leads east.

You can see Johnny Pike's jacket here.
